name: everyone-can-use-english
one_liner: An AI-powered app and browser extension that helps you learn English by practicing with real videos, flashcards, and pronunciation feedback, built around 'record yourself for 1,000 hours' training method.
buyer: An independent English tutor or small language school (especially serving Chinese-speaking students) who wants a branded practice app for their students instead of building one from scratch.
business_use_cases: A language school white-labels the app as their own student practice platform, keeping students engaged between lessons.
An individual tutor sells access to a customized version bundled with their paid course content (videos, ebooks).
A corporate training company offers it as an English-fluency tool for employees at companies expanding into English-speaking markets.

money_ideas.idea: Bundle a customized version with paid tutoring or course packages, charging per student per month.
Sell curated content packs (structured video/podcast courses) as one-time purchases inside the app.
Freemium browser extension with premium features (advanced flashcards, unlimited recordings) as an upsell.

steal_this: Pick one YouTube channel's content, load it into the app, and sell 'guided English practice with this show' to one small tutoring business as a pilot this weekend.
